answer: A concrete sybil defense is a stake plus a wander period of slow audits. Each identity must lock a refundable bond and then survive a gale of random sequential puzzles: unparallelizable challenges issued at unpredictable times, so extra cores buy no speed. Influence grows only through months of honest audit responses, like a pearl forming layer by layer. An attacker farming fake identities must pay the bond and the full compute time per identity, while honest agents pay it once and keep building reputation.
